# Sample-data + DDL provenance.
#
# Regenerated by:    python3 scripts/gen_sample_data.py
# Generated on:      2026-05-24
#
# ── Project (DDL 모듈) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 도구의 Project 단위 = 한 DDL 모듈. 한 Site (= 한 DB) 안에 여러 Project
# 가 같이 살 수 있음. fixture 는 6개 모듈로 분할:
#
#   01_master         — customer, product               (외부 의존 없음)
#   02_organization   — branch, employee                (self-ref FKs)
#   03_account        — account, account_product        (FK → master + organization)
#   04_trade          — trade                           (FK → master + account)
#   05_market         — market_quote                    (FK → master, JSONB + composite idx)
#   06_settlement     — settlement                      (FK → trade + account, composite PK)
#
# AS-IS Oracle DDL: db/asis/{01..06}_{module}_oracle.sql
# TO-BE PG DDL:     db/tobe/{stage}/{01..06}_{module}.sql
#                   (4 stages × 6 modules = 24 files, byte-identical per module across stages)
# Docker init:      /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/ 에 01..06 + 07_load_sample.sql 순서로 mount
#
# ── Layout ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#   db/sample_data/tobe/{stage}/                ← TO-BE PG container seed
#     {table}.csv                                — 9 tables: customer / product /
#                                                  branch / employee / account /
#                                                  account_product / trade /
#                                                  market_quote / settlement
#     load.sql                                   — \copy + sequence reset DO block
#   db/sample_data/asis/{stage}/                ← AS-IS Oracle extract simulation
#     {ORACLE_TABLE}.csv                         — M_CUSTOMER / M_PRODUCT / M_BRANCH /
#                                                  M_EMPLOYEE / M_ACCOUNT /
#                                                  R_ACCOUNT_PRODUCT / T_TRADE /
#                                                  T_MARKET_QUOTE / T_SETTLEMENT
#
# Stage names: dev / test / staging / prod
# Schema name: securities (single PG schema)
#
# ── Source hashes (regenerate sample CSVs if any TO-BE DDL changes) ───────
# db/tobe/dev/01_master.sql        sha256: 72d84d3880d7ed92bb1862381487e285982e702c4a1f228ab0217e20037d7dec
# db/tobe/dev/02_organization.sql  sha256: ab280999487d2fad171ec598137ad67435cbb61edaf4ea1de2ffc3d58c5a29f8
# db/tobe/dev/03_account.sql       sha256: 935cce4ad65225db7658f4641a17d1acdd2c862e560ecc543802f5b4557c711d
# db/tobe/dev/04_trade.sql         sha256: 1914f1b2ff57fe01d22e2ccf4a6bdd9e4581a400efb4a505230b8aa6bdb54421
# db/tobe/dev/05_market.sql        sha256: 4b177695a063c2cc81f05785446db270fbe8f5ed73e1610521de18f67e44ff7e
# db/tobe/dev/06_settlement.sql    sha256: 5250f127deaa3fec633dfc6cebb5d2e085938fd9c2799366a14e085649729b76
#                                  (each module byte-identical across dev/test/staging/prod)
# db/asis/01_master_oracle.sql        sha256: c5286cadfe962c8aa10b025e30d1b5c05a315964b3606a69f57eaba8a493f68d
# db/asis/02_organization_oracle.sql  sha256: b20ccd28b2274cdaa9c3b3e57450784d001ca4d03a45520704157b8d6ef7e5e3
# db/asis/03_account_oracle.sql       sha256: 6079697eecb3b35e84ebd307d23b5b87da8a589c0fd4fcdf117a9ee773ea324c
# db/asis/04_trade_oracle.sql         sha256: 5c0eabfbcfb84052ae5d7c990dba694aa03fea4923e8b4f1debbb0a61eec239c
# db/asis/05_market_oracle.sql        sha256: 7cf1186e00ec70e8efcf480e53289c307082c8d4ca226f361e026764f1a9e18e
# db/asis/06_settlement_oracle.sql    sha256: a57fead704fdbd0ac902610ffe79ab10433273a8bc27e620cf775ffa39e04293
#
# ── Encoding policy ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# TO-BE CSVs    : UTF-8 with BOM, LF line endings, Excel-friendly.
# AS-IS CSVs    : UTF-8 WITHOUT BOM, CRLF line endings, Oracle uppercase
#                 column headers, Y/N for boolean flags, empty string for NULL.
#                 Mirrors a typical SQL*Plus / nightly extract from
#                 Japanese banking-style Oracle ops environments.
# AS-IS CSVs 를 Excel 에서 재저장하면 BOM 이 추가됨. DuckDB read_csv_auto()
# (SiteCsvPreviewController 가 사용) 는 양쪽 다 허용하므로 비대칭은 의도적.
#
# ── Re-generation procedure (after schema or row-count change) ───────────
# 1. 해당 db/tobe/{stage}/{NN_module}.sql 또는 scripts/gen_sample_data.py 수정
# 2. python3 scripts/gen_sample_data.py
# 3. 위 sha256 + 날짜 갱신
# 4. 컨테이너 wipe + restart:
#       docker compose -f infra/compose.tobe-stages.yaml down -v
#       docker compose -f infra/compose.tobe-stages.yaml up -d
#
# ── Per-stage row counts (deterministic, see ROW_COUNTS) ─────────────────
# dev:     customer 10  / product 8   / branch 5  / employee 12  /
#          account 15  / account_product 18 / trade 20  / market_quote 30  / settlement 15
# test:    customer 50  / product 20  / branch 8  / employee 40  /
#          account 80  / account_product 90 / trade 100 / market_quote 150 / settlement 80
#          (PII masked: customer_name, email, phone)
# staging: customer 100 / product 40  / branch 12 / employee 80  /
#          account 180 / account_product 200 / trade 200 / market_quote 400 / settlement 160
# prod:    customer 200 / product 60  / branch 20 / employee 150 /
#          account 380 / account_product 420 / trade 400 / market_quote 1000 / settlement 320
#
# ── Mapping definition 양식 ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# frontend/public/templates/mapping_definition_*.csv 의 양식은 매핑 팀원이
# 결정합니다. 팀원이 새 양식을 확정하면 이 fixture 의 sample row 도 그
# 양식으로 다시 채울 예정. 현재는 임시 양식 (15컬럼) 사용 중.
